source.title: Association of Immune-Related Adverse Events With Nivolumab Efficacy in Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer

source_integrity_findings.finding: The abstract and Table 2 report different adjusted hazard ratios for any irAE at the 6-week landmark. PFS is 0.525 (95% CI 0.287-0.937; P=.03) in the abstract versus 0.542 (0.295-0.971; P=.04) in Table 2. OS is 0.282 (0.101-0.667; P=.003) in the abstract versus 0.285 (0.102-0.675; P=.003) in Table 2.
source_integrity_findings.handling: Both source assertions were preserved as separate atoms and tagged for source reconciliation. No value was silently corrected.

protocol_version_note: The governing filename is summary-evaluation-appraisal-protocol-v4-compact.md, while its internal heading says Integrated Compact v3. Project precedence names the v4 filename, so that file governed this run.
schema_gaps: QuantitativeResult requires a numeric estimate and numeric interval bounds. Kaplan-Meier medians or confidence limits reported as not reached cannot be represented directly. Those values are preserved in canonical_statement and original_result_text, with a numeric reported group value used as the structured estimate when available.
extraction_limitations: The study is retrospective and observational. The atoms preserve associations and do not convert them into causal effects.
Landmark analyses reduce lead-time bias but select patients who survive or maintain disease control to each landmark, and the composition changes across 4-, 6-, and 8-week analyses.
The current extraction captures major patient characteristics and all material result families rather than one atom for every baseline-table cell or every adverse-event subtype.
All atoms remain needs_review because no independent human reviewer step is represented.
No external bibliographic correction, erratum search, or current-practice verification was performed because @VERIFY was not activated.
